const numericalLetterGrade = (grades) => {
    const gradeMap = {
        '4.0': 'A+',
        '3.7': 'A',
        '3.3': 'A-',
        '3.0': 'B+',
        '2.7': 'B',
        '2.3': 'B-',
        '2.0': 'C+',
        '1.7': 'C',
        '1.3': 'C-',
        '1.0': 'D+',
        '0.7': 'D',
        '0.0': 'D-',
        '-1.0': 'E'
    }
    return grades.map(num => gradeMap[Object.keys(gradeMap).reduce((acc, numKey) => parseFloat(numKey) < num ? numKey : acc, '-1.0')])
}
